svg.text: 9 tables | 60 columns | 9 foreign keys | PPM: INT | Crow foot notation
PK = primary key; FK = foreign key; UQ = unique.
NULL: Yes means the column may be empty.
Two bars = exactly one; circle + bar = zero or one.
Circle + crow foot = zero to many (N).
R1-R9 refer to the relationships on page two.
Schedule: schedule_id = 1; at most one row.
In monitoring and notifications, the two reading
IDs cannot both be set in the same row.
Both may be NULL for general records.
A: admin / user B: ppm / ph / dithane C: warning / success / info D: owner / team
The Dithane category remains in settings for log references; schedule parameters are stored in dithane_schedules.
The schedule relationship uses 0..1 because the entire schedule table allows at most one row.
Source: database/schema.sql. Column names and types match the current implementation.
